documents_ownership_mode_check.name: documents_ownership_mode_check
documents_ownership_mode_check.value:
(
        (
          "documents"."property_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "documents"."brokerage_id" IS NULL
          AND "documents"."logical_owner_type" IS NULL
          AND "documents"."logical_owner_id" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "documents"."property_id" IS NULL
          AND "documents"."brokerage_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "documents"."logical_owner_type" IS NOT NULL
          AND "documents"."logical_owner_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "documents"."package_id" IS NULL
        )
      )

ai_action_requests_open_grow_commitment_.name: ai_action_requests_open_grow_commitment_resource_uidx
ai_action_requests_open_grow_commitment_.where: "ai_action_requests"."action_key" = 'CREATE_GROW_COMMITMENT' AND "ai_action_requests"."resource_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ai_action_requests"."status" IN ('AWAITING_APPROVAL', 'APPROVED', 'EXECUTING')

pit_crew_responsibility_events_one_recip.name: pit_crew_responsibility_events_one_recipient_check
pit_crew_responsibility_events_one_recip.value: ("pit_crew_responsibility_events"."recipient_user_id" is not null)::int + ("pit_crew_responsibility_events"."recipient_role" is not null)::int = 1

pit_crew_responsibility_events_hand_back.name: pit_crew_responsibility_events_hand_back_shape_check
pit_crew_responsibility_events_hand_back.value:
"pit_crew_responsibility_events"."kind" <> 'HAND_BACK' OR (
        "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."severity" is null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."expected_response_at" is null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."resulting_responsibility" = 'AGENT'
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."status" in ('OPEN', 'SUPERSEDED')
      )

pit_crew_responsibility_events_escalatio.name: pit_crew_responsibility_events_escalation_shape_check
pit_crew_responsibility_events_escalatio.value:
"pit_crew_responsibility_events"."kind" <> 'ESCALATION' OR (
        "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."severity" is not null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."severity" in ('ATTENTION', 'AT_RISK', 'CRITICAL')
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."resulting_responsibility" = 'BROKERAGE_ADMINISTRATOR'
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."status" in ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED', 'RESOLVED', 'RETURNED')
      )

pit_crew_responsibility_events_acknowled.name: pit_crew_responsibility_events_acknowledgement_check
pit_crew_responsibility_events_acknowled.value:
(
        "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."acknowledged_at" is null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."acknowledged_by_user_id" is null
      ) or (
        "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."acknowledged_at" is not null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."acknowledged_by_user_id" is not null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."status" in ('ACKNOWLEDGED', 'RESOLVED', 'RETURNED')
      )

pit_crew_responsibility_events_closed_ch.name: pit_crew_responsibility_events_closed_check
pit_crew_responsibility_events_closed_ch.value:
(
        "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."status" in ('OPEN', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."closed_at" is null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."closed_by_user_id" is null
      ) or (
        "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."status" in ('RESOLVED', 'RETURNED', 'SUPERSEDED')
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."closed_at" is not null
        and "pit_crew_responsibility_events"."closed_by_user_id" is not null
      )

communication_messages_property_or_party.name: communication_messages_property_or_party_check
communication_messages_property_or_party.value: property_id IS NOT NULL OR party_id IS NOT NULL

communication_threads_property_or_party_.name: communication_threads_property_or_party_check
communication_threads_property_or_party_.value: property_id IS NOT NULL OR party_id IS NOT NULL

fee_schedule_versions_activation_check.name: fee_schedule_versions_activation_check
fee_schedule_versions_activation_check.value: ("fee_schedule_versions"."status" = 'DRAFT') = ("fee_schedule_versions"."activated_at" is null) and ("fee_schedule_versions"."activated_at" is null) = ("fee_schedule_versions"."activated_by_user_id" is null)

settlement_statement_lines_source_check.name: settlement_statement_lines_source_check
settlement_statement_lines_source_check.value: ("settlement_statement_lines"."kind" <> 'PC_SERVICE_FEE' or "settlement_statement_lines"."payment_request_id" is not null) and ("settlement_statement_lines"."kind" not in ('COMMISSION', 'COMMISSION_GST') or "settlement_statement_lines"."commission_calculation_id" is not null) and ("settlement_statement_lines"."kind" not in ('AE_ADMIN_FEE', 'SETTLEMENT_FEE', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'DEDUCTION') or "settlement_statement_lines"."transaction_fee_id" is not null)

settlement_statements_payer_check.name: settlement_statements_payer_check
settlement_statements_payer_check.value: ("settlement_statements"."payer_type" = 'Agent' and "settlement_statements"."payer_user_id" is not null and "settlement_statements"."payer_brokerage_id" is null) or ("settlement_statements"."payer_type" = 'Brokerage' and "settlement_statements"."payer_brokerage_id" is not null and "settlement_statements"."payer_user_id" is null)

settlement_statements_totals_check.name: settlement_statements_totals_check
settlement_statements_totals_check.value: "settlement_statements"."credits_cents" >= 0 and "settlement_statements"."debits_cents" >= 0 and "settlement_statements"."net_cents" = "settlement_statements"."credits_cents" - "settlement_statements"."debits_cents" and ("settlement_statements"."pc_service_fee_cents" is null or "settlement_statements"."pc_service_fee_cents" >= 0)

settlement_statements_issued_check.name: settlement_statements_issued_check
settlement_statements_issued_check.value: ("settlement_statements"."status" = 'DRAFT') = ("settlement_statements"."issued_at" is null) and ("settlement_statements"."issued_at" is null) = ("settlement_statements"."issued_by_user_id" is null) and ("settlement_statements"."status" = 'DRAFT' or ("settlement_statements"."buyer_confirmation_id" is not null and "settlement_statements"."seller_confirmation_id" is not null))

settlement_statements_superseded_check.name: settlement_statements_superseded_check
settlement_statements_superseded_check.value: ("settlement_statements"."status" = 'SUPERSEDED') = ("settlement_statements"."superseded_at" is not null) and ("settlement_statements"."superseded_at" is null) = ("settlement_statements"."superseded_by_user_id" is null)

grow_contact_channel_consents_inferred_e.name: grow_contact_channel_consents_inferred_evidence_check
grow_contact_channel_consents_inferred_e.value:
state <> 'INFERRED' OR (
        length(trim(coalesce(inferred_reasoning, ''))) > 0
        AND length(trim(coalesce(evidence_reference, ''))) > 0
        AND relationship_evidence IS NOT NULL
        AND inferred_evidence_reviewed_at IS NOT NULL
        AND inferred_evidence_reviewed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL
      )

grow_contact_channel_consents_withdrawal.name: grow_contact_channel_consents_withdrawal_fields_check
grow_contact_channel_consents_withdrawal.value:
state <> 'WITHDRAWN' OR (
        withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL
        AND withdrawn_by_user_id IS NOT NULL
        AND length(trim(coalesce(withdrawal_reason, ''))) > 0
      )
